title: Tây Ninh, sheet 6231 IV, U.S. Army 1:50,000 topographic map, series L7014
citation: Tây Ninh, Vietnam, Sheet 6231 IV, Series L7014, edition 3-TPC, 1:50,000; prepared by the 29th Engineer Battalion, U.S. Army, 1970, by photo revision of L7014 maps; names data by NGS Vietnam; printed by 29th Engr Bn (BT) 11-70. Stock no. L701462314. Vietnam Archive Map Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, sheet 6231-4.
notes: The 1:50,000 sheet covering Núi Bà Đen and Tây Ninh city. Shows the massif with its named peaks (Núi Bà Đen 986, Núi Cậu, Núi Đất/Núi Heo) and the Điện Bà pagoda, the settlements around its foot, and a fortification symbol on the road some ten kilometres north of the summit. IMPORTANT LIMIT: this is a 1970 photo revision, not a 1965 sheet, so its depiction of which hamlets stood and which were destroyed records the state of the ground in 1970 and cannot be read back onto 1964–65.
